invariants: News is a discovery layer; canonical domains own civic facts and statuses.
Publisher class is descriptive and never a credibility score.
Today requires both freshness and direct Makati/entity relevance.
Story clustering preserves alternate coverage and uses a conservative time-bounded similarity rule.
Canonical relationships require explicit names, references or exact source matches; news never creates canonical entities.
Topic routing creates internal review candidates only.
Resolved stories are suppressed until materially new official/canonical evidence appears; stale and out-of-scope are terminal for the matched story.
Resolution history is human/editorial state and is never overwritten by the daily generator.
Internal news-review artifacts are not copied to the public site.

bounded.reason: W5-8 intentionally avoids broad semantic/AI clustering that could merge distinct civic developments.
Owner-specific primary/official evidence and destination-domain review remain mandatory.
Ordinary dining, entertainment, lifestyle and commercial coverage may appear in News but does not enter the civic review queue without a civic-change signal.
The queue and resolution ledger are editorial workflow state rather than public civic records.

deferred.reason: Repository closure precedes a fresh deployment/browser pass.
deferred.nonClaim: No repository-level result in W5-8 establishes that production has already deployed these changes.

deferred.reason: A closed discovery/review system may still contain active editorial candidates. Closure concerns the workflow architecture, not the resolution of every future headline.

finalStatement: W5-8 News & Discovery is closed at repository level with human editorial review, canonical-owner evidence boundaries, recurrence suppression, and deployment verification explicitly preserved.
